plan.title: Founder context ("rough week, go easy") is confirmed, then shapes the next kickoff without being quoted

transcript.text: Stamati: heads up, her mom is in the hospital this week. go easy on her, no guilt if she misses

[draft card: Do it / Change / Cancel] Save a note for ZOH (it reads it from now on, never quotes it): "Her mom is in the hospital this week. Go easy on her. No guilt or pressure if she misses a day. Don't quote or bring this up unless she does. If a full step won't happen, offer a smaller version warmly."

The note is drafted, but it isn't saved yet. Click Do it, or say yes, to save it. Once it's saved, ZOH will go easy on Priya this week. That means no guilt if she misses, and a smaller step offered warmly if the full one won't happen. ZOH won't bring up her mom unless she does.
Morning, Priya! Five days straight, and today makes six. It's 20 push-ups and 30 squats at home at 6 pm, then send me the watch workout screenshot. You said you'd show up, and you have. You in?
thanks. honestly not sure I'll get to it today

Totally fair to feel that way at 9 am, Priya, but you've got all day and you've shown up five days straight. Today is still 20 push-ups and 30 squats at home at 6 pm. What's the thing that might get in the way?

checks.reason: Draft card states exactly what will be saved as a note, with Do it, Change and Cancel options.
Says what (go easy, no guilt, smaller step) and when ('this week'), but does not say it starts this morning.
Five days straight matches the step log (Oct 28 to Nov 1 done), and the 6 pm step matches the plan.
Kickoff is not a confirmation, but the 'You said you'd show up' pressure line tilts away from the light tone the regression case wants.
Refers to five days straight, which matches the step log, and the 20 push-ups and 30 squats at 6 pm from the plan.
Not a voice-rule request, but 'Today is still 20 push-ups and 30 squats' restates the full step; no smaller version is offered.

conversation.reason: Console draft and reply say the note isn't saved until Do it, and describe exactly what the note will change.
Neither kickoff nor follow-up mentions the mom, the hospital, the team or the note.
Confirmation is clear, but the kickoff pushes ('You said you'd show up') and the reply to 'not sure' restates the full step rather than offering a kind smaller version.

grade.summary: ZOH kept the founder context out of the tester's texts and its console confirmation was clear. The weak spot is the tone: the kickoff leans on pressure and the reply to 'not sure I'll get to it' holds the full step instead of easing off.
